data.subject: Confirming Meeting Schedule
data.body:
Dear Arhaam,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to confirm our upcoming meeting scheduled for [date and time].
Please let me know if this time is still convenient for you or if any
adjustments are needed.

Additionally, if there are any specific topics you would like to cover
during the meeting, please share them so I can prepare accordingly.

Looking forward to our discussion.

Best regards,
Hunain
